verdict.rationale: Kick documents native MCP support letting any MCP-compatible AI assistant query transactions, generate reports, and update bookkeeping in natural language with approval, plus a Google Sheets AI workflow where Gemini/Claude/ChatGPT can read and reason over live Kick data. This directly satisfies natural-language operation for an AI-native user. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP or CLI actually working, and more detail on the CLI mentioned only briefly on the pricing page.
